title: Airbnb just found an unexpected way to make AI pay

content_html:
Airbnb (ABNB) has spent years telling investors artificial intelligence could transform travel.

Now it has a number to back up that claim.

Airbnb shares surged about 14% on Aug. 7 to their highest level in four years after the company raised its annual revenue-growth outlook and reported better-than-expected second-quarter results, Reuters reported.

Revenue increased 17% to $3.61 billion, while the company now expects full-year revenue growth in the mid-teens rather than its previous low-to-mid-teens forecast.

But one figure buried in those data may matter more to stockholders. Airbnb claimed its AI customer-support assistant upgrades helped reduce support costs per booking by 16% compared to a year ago, according to Reuters.

This is important because AI investment across corporate America has posed a tough challenge for investors: Where is the refund?

Airbnb is starting to offer an answer. Instead of just adding a chatbot to its website, the company is using AI to answer consumer problems, improve search, and accelerate product development.

And for travelers, that may mean speedier help and easier booking.

For stockholders, it may be something even more precious; it may mean higher revenue while costs do not grow at the same pace.

Airbnb's travel demand stayed strong, despite headwinds

Airbnb's quarter came against an uncomfortable backdrop. Consumers have pulled back because of geopolitical risk, higher travel costs, and inflation.

Still, global travel demand remains strong as Airbnb posted $3.61 billion in quarterly revenue and raised its outlook, Reuters confirmed. Gross bookings totaled $27.2 billion, and adjusted profitability also beat estimates, according to Investors Business Daily.

Related: Airbnb CEO delivers eye-opening message on future of travel

Another advancement could grow the market Airbnb can serve: Hotel room nights on the platform are growing approximately three times faster than home listings.

That alters what Airbnb can do. The company's first hotel disruption was offering residences to travelers. Now it can progressively sell hotel inventory along with those homes.

That gives travelers more options and allows Airbnb to compete for vacations that would otherwise have gone to Booking Holdings, Expedia, or a hotel's own website.

Airbnb's AI savings finally answer Wall Street's biggest question

The IT industry has spent hundreds of billions of dollars creating the infrastructure for AI. Investors are now demanding proof that these investments are delivering measurable returns.

content_html_zh:
Airbnb (ABNB) 多年来一直告诉投资者人工智能可以改变旅行方式。

现在它有一个数字来支持这一说法。

据路透社报道，在该公司上调年度收入增长预期并公布好于预期的第二季度业绩后，8 月 7 日 Airbnb 股价飙升约 14%，达到四年来的最高水平。

收入增长 17%，达到 36.1 亿美元，而该公司目前预计全年收入增长将达到十几岁左右，而不是之前预测的十几岁左右。

但这些数据中隐藏的一个数字对股东来说可能更重要。 据路透社报道，Airbnb 声称其人工智能客户支持助理升级帮助每次预订的支持成本比一年前降低了 16%。

这一点很重要，因为美国企业界的人工智能投资给投资者带来了严峻的挑战：退款在哪里？

Airbnb 开始给出答案。 该公司不只是在其网站上添加聊天机器人，而是使用人工智能来回答消费者问题、改进搜索并加速产品开发。

对于旅行者来说，这可能意味着更快的帮助和更轻松的预订。

对于股东来说，可能更是弥足珍贵；这可能意味着更高的收入，而成本却没有以同样的速度增长。

尽管面临阻力，Airbnb 的旅行需求依然强劲

Airbnb 本季度的背景令人不安。 由于地缘政治风险、旅行成本上升和通货膨胀，消费者已经退出。

路透社证实，尽管如此，全球旅游需求依然强劲，Airbnb 公布的季度收入为 36.1 亿美元，并上调了预期。 据《投资者商业日报》报道，总预订额总计 272 亿美元，调整后的盈利能力也超出了预期。

相关：Airbnb 首席执行官就旅行的未来发表了令人大开眼界的信息

另一项进步可能会扩大 Airbnb 服务的市场：该平台上的酒店间夜增长速度大约是房屋列表的三倍。

这改变了 Airbnb 的能力。 该公司对酒店的第一次颠覆是为旅行者提供住宿。 现在，它可以逐步出售酒店库存以及这些房屋。

这为旅行者提供了更多选择，并让 Airbnb 能够争夺本来可以通过 Booking Holdings、Expedia 或酒店自有网站预订的假期。

Airbnb 的人工智能储蓄终于回答了华尔街最大的问题

IT 行业已花费数千亿美元创建人工智能基础设施。 投资者现在要求提供证据，证明这些投资正在带来可衡量的回报。
